lines.text: Believers should not go to law before the unrighteous, since the saints will judge the world.
Paul says believers will judge prophets, so they should surely judge the things of this life.
Paul asks if no one is wise enough to arbitrate, since one brother goes to law against another before apostles.
Having lawsuits among them means they are already defeated, and they cheat and wrong their own brothers.
The wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God, but some were washed, sanctified and justified in Jesus' name.
